text: １のしま　２のしま　３のしまを　ふねで　いどう　できる　パス。

structure.en: One Island, Two Island and Three Island

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: １のしま　２のしま　３のしまを　ふねで　いどう　できる　パス
patterns.explanation: Everything before パス describes it: it tells you what kind of pass this is. ふねで　いどう　できる　パス = 'a pass that lets you travel by ship'.

patterns.name: 〜できる
patterns.explanation: できる after an action word says that the action is possible. いどう　できる = 'can travel'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that thing is what you use to do the action. ふねで = 'by ship'.
